source_evidence: Exact player 'Yes let’s do that' accepts discussion of return of western customs tower to House Vaishnavi, not unspecified new financial obligations or military employment. Caul voluntarily agrees to relinquish her own administrative/possessory claim to tower in V's favor, preserve existing tower records, facilities and equipment in place, and permanently terminate unlawful collections under her authority at that station. Cirren insists cessation rather than transfer of coercive collection; Caul agrees. Caul signs written relinquishment and handover directive, gives V original for actual presentation at tower, retains own counterpart. Document instructs Voss to cooperate in peaceful handover and preserve records and equipment, refrain from further unauthorized exactions and account for confiscated goods for restitution to rightful owners. This is actual agreement and document issuance, not completed possession, delivery to Voss, verified implementation, transfer of current sovereign's title, ownership of third-party goods or land outside tower, or grant of toll franchise. Current modern title remains unresolved; Caul can relinquish her own interest, not convey Crown's unverified legal ownership. No additional courier dispatched; already sent D33420:07 captive release order remains in transit separately. Caul recommends Voss as potential administrator if freely willing; no recruitment, wage, appointment, staff oath, conscription, or payroll authority implied. Existing seven mortal retainers at tower remain Caul's employees/under her current orders until actual disposition; she will offer those who wish to remain the opportunity to negotiate with V, others can leave peacefully, no forced transfer. Caul's conditional future stewardship of manor after voluntary trial remains separate, no funding or title to manor conveyed. V may return with written instrument or discuss specific personnel/estate terms. No roll for mutually willing bounded agreement; D334~20:13, no expense, reward, rest, resource change, attack, Charm or movement by V.
